column6:
The skills "Spirit Step" and "Chain: Spirit Step" are similar but not quite the same.
- Spirit Step (iFrame into standing SA recovery)
- Chain: Spirit Step (SA into iFrame when disappeared into rolling SA recovery)

The "Spirit Step" version is better for protection, as it allows you to completely cancel the SA recovery animation, going into an other iFrame or Forward Guard. The "Chain: Spirit Step" version will always have a short rolling SA recovery animation, however it does have increased movement distance and very long lingering SA if not cancelled.

shift+W
Forward movement with this skill usually uses "Chain: Spirit Step" first, which you might not want to do. However all skills flow into "shift+W", using "Spirit Step" rather than "Chain: Spirit Step".
Tip: You can hold down LMB for forward "Spirit Step", as LMB is a skill. Just make sure to input "W+LMB+shift" or "LMB+W+shift" in that order.


Note:

For some cancels it will matter if you use "Spirit Step" or "Chain: Spirit Step", as well as the input direction that you use. The color of the skills in this info will be the same as in the table, make sure to also pay attention to the inputs for these skills!

column6:
This is the unique mechanic of Succession Maegu, which allows you to create a clone of yourself after the following skills:

- Bared Claws (A/D+LMB)
- Soul Tear (W+Q)
- Flower Shroud (W+E)
  Note: S+E does not work!

You can only ever have 1 clone active at a given time and they last 3s. While a clone is active you can swap positions with it using "Prime: Foxspirit: Deceiver (Q)". You can even swap positions while you are using other skills, finishing the cast where you teleport to. Do however pay attention to "Q", as it is unprotected and will cause a very short unprotected frame, even if using protected skills.

All of this is important for Cancels & Flows, as this mechanic simply changes your location but does not interfere with skill interactions. Meaning you can use Q at any time and Cancels & Flows will work normally. As it does not affect any Cancels or Flows, it is not listed for each skill, but is important to know.

Every skill can flow into the following skills, activating them instantly, without starting animations:

- Prime: Spirit Swirl (shift+F)
- Prime: Bristling Sparks (shift+RMB)
- Absolute: Charmed (SPACE)
- Spirit Step (shift+A/S/D)

Note: These interactions are only mentioned for these skills, as every skill works.
